bodyLift.heroSubtitle: Comprehensive Body Contouring After Weight Loss
bodyLift.heroDesc1: Massive weight loss is a physiological victory, but it often leaves behind a stubborn anatomical reminder: excess, lax skin that the body cannot retract on its own. This loose skin commonly affects the abdomen, waist, hips, thighs, buttocks, and lower back, causing not just cosmetic dissatisfaction but real problems with movement, hygiene, posture, and clothing fit.
bodyLift.heroDesc2: A body lift is a comprehensive surgical solution designed to restore proportion, contour, and physical comfort after significant weight loss. Unlike isolated cosmetic procedures, a body lift addresses the body circumferentially, reshaping multiple regions in a single coordinated plan.
bodyLift.heroDesc3: In Malaysia, body lift surgery is classified as a major surgical procedure. It must be performed by a registered medical practitioner in a licensed medical facility, under standards regulated by the Ministry of Health Malaysia (MOH), which oversees private healthcare services, surgical safety, and patient protection.
bodyLift.whatDesc1: A body lift is a reconstructive and contouring surgical procedure that removes excess skin and fat from multiple body areas, most commonly in patients who have experienced massive weight loss following bariatric surgery, medical treatment, or lifestyle changes.
bodyLift.whatDesc2: Major academic medical centres describe body lift surgery as an effective option to improve body contour, mobility, hygiene, and overall quality of life in post–weight loss patients.
bodyLift.whatNotPoint: Not a weight loss substitute – it is for contouring
bodyLift.whatYesPoint: Yes – it improves comfort, hygiene, and mobility
bodyLift.whyTitle: Why a Body Lift Is Often Necessary
bodyLift.whyDesc: From a biological perspective, skin behaves like an elastic material only up to a point. Prolonged stretching during obesity leads to structural damage of collagen and elastin fibres. Once this damage occurs, the skin cannot fully retract, even after substantial fat loss.
bodyLift.laxity1Desc: Loose, sagging tissue that cannot retract after weight loss
bodyLift.laxity2Desc: Fungal and bacterial infections in skin folds
bodyLift.laxity3Desc: Problems with walking, exercise, and daily activities
bodyLift.laxity5Desc: Emotional challenges despite successful weight loss
bodyLift.laxity6Desc: Difficulty maintaining proper hygiene in skin folds
bodyLift.areasTitle: Areas Addressed in a Body Lift
bodyLift.areasDesc: A body lift is customised to each patient after a full clinical assessment. Because these regions are anatomically connected, addressing them together produces more balanced and durable results.
bodyLift.processMainTitle: How Body Lift Surgery Is Performed
bodyLift.processMainDesc: Body lift surgery is performed in a hospital setting under general anaesthesia. The operation is technically demanding and requires advanced surgical planning.
bodyLift.typesDesc: The surgical approach depends on the distribution of excess skin, overall health, and recovery tolerance. The choice is individualised after medical evaluation.
bodyLift.type1Desc: Targets the abdomen, waist, hips, buttocks, and outer thighs. This is the most common form performed after massive weight loss.
bodyLift.type2Desc: Addresses excess skin of the upper back, chest, arms, and breasts.
bodyLift.type3Desc: Provides comprehensive correction around the entire torso.
bodyLift.type4Desc: Divides procedures into multiple safer phases for patients who require extensive correction or have medical considerations.
bodyLift.benefitsDesc: Many patients report that a body lift completes their weight-loss journey, allowing their physical appearance to reflect their effort and discipline.
bodyLift.benefit1Desc: Remove large volumes of redundant skin
bodyLift.benefit3Desc: Elimination of chronic skin rashes and hygiene issues
bodyLift.benefit5Desc: Permanent when body weight remains stable
bodyLift.benefit6Desc: Physical appearance reflects weight loss effort
bodyLift.candidateDesc: Suitable candidates for body lift surgery generally meet specific criteria to ensure safe and effective results.
bodyLift.candidate1: Maintained stable weight after massive weight loss
bodyLift.candidate2: Experience functional or aesthetic problems due to excess skin
bodyLift.candidate4: Non-smoker or able to stop smoking temporarily
bodyLift.candidate5: Understand scarring, recovery time, and realistic outcomes
bodyLift.floatingBadgeDesc: Every body lift procedure is personally performed by Dr. Soma, ensuring continuity of care and precise surgical planning.
bodyLift.compareDesc: A common point of confusion is the difference between a body lift and a tummy tuck. A tummy tuck treats the front of the abdomen only, while a body lift addresses the body circumferentially.
bodyLift.recoveryDesc: Recovery follows a predictable physiological course when postoperative instructions are followed.

bodyLift.faqDesc: Get answers to common concerns about body lift surgery
bodyLift.faq1A: A body lift is a surgical procedure that removes excess skin and fat from multiple body areas to improve contour after major weight loss.
bodyLift.faq2A: When performed by a certified plastic surgeon in a licensed hospital setting, it is a well-established and safe procedure.
bodyLift.faq3A: Initial recovery takes about 2–3 weeks, with full healing over several months.
bodyLift.faq4A: Yes. Scarring is unavoidable but strategically placed and typically fades over time.
bodyLift.faq5A: Postoperative discomfort is expected but usually well controlled with medication.
bodyLift.faq6Q: Can a body lift be done in one surgery?
bodyLift.faq6A: Some patients undergo a single-stage procedure; others benefit from a staged approach.
bodyLift.faq7A: Results are long-lasting if body weight remains stable.
bodyLift.faq8Q: Who should avoid body lift surgery?
bodyLift.faq8A: Patients with unstable weight, uncontrolled medical conditions, or unrealistic expectations.
bodyLift.safetyDesc: In Malaysia, body lift surgery falls under private healthcare services regulated by the Ministry of Health Malaysia.
bodyLift.safety1Desc: Facilities must be licensed, and surgeons must be fully registered and credentialed under MOH regulations.
bodyLift.safety2Desc: Professional surgical standards align with international best practices for body contouring surgery.
bodyLift.safety3Desc: All procedures performed in licensed hospital settings with full monitoring and sterile environments.
bodyLift.ctaTitle: Ready to complete your transformation journey?
bodyLift.ctaDesc: At Dr. Soma Plastic Surgery, every body lift procedure is personally performed by Dr. Soma, ensuring continuity of care, precise surgical planning, and hospital-grade safety.
